LearningGoals: Determine areas under a normal curve.
Interpret (orally and in writing) the proportion of values in certain intervals under a normal curve in a variety of different contexts.
SourceAuthority: Local Kendall Hunt archival teacher/student pages; AccessIM v360 excluded

CoreMathWorkedExample.Question: Approximately what fraction of a normal population lies within one standard deviation of its mean?
Steps: Use standard normal area from z=-1 to z=1.

GradingRubric: teacher verifies diagrams, graphs, card work and explanation

FirstPartyCoolDown.Prompt: About what fraction lies outside ±1 SD?
